integrity: The upper bound follows from the orthogonal two-component update attached to every nonpivot coordinate. Sharpness is realized by an explicit three-dimensional symmetric family, shifted by a scalar identity term chosen to enforce any prescribed SPD spectral condition number. The same first rotation leaves exactly one off-diagonal entry, so the second rotation terminates exactly. The standalone checker replays the representative family but is not used as a substitute for the universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic one-step theorem for the classical maximum-element two-sided Jacobi eigenvalue method on real symmetric matrices. It classifies the largest individual off-diagonal magnitude, not full-sweep complexity, finite-precision behavior, or block Jacobi methods.
title: A sharp max-entry transient law for maximum-pivot Jacobi diagonalization
